blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Read parentheses, braces, tags, and punctuation is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Read code from outside inward and map every symbol to an opening, closing, value, or instruction. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.

To master Read parentheses, braces, tags, and punctuation, first build a minimal version with explicit rules, then inspect it on mobile and desktop. Contrast normal, empty, long, and error cases. This lesson delivers a line-by-line reading sheet for a first component. It must record the starting situation, decision, expected evidence, and safety limit. Compare behavior and before/after metrics over enough time while accounting for traffic, costs, and satisfaction.

blocks.text: Reproduce, read file and line, reduce the case, verify the hypothesis, and rerun types and build instead of editing randomly. A sound decision always connects the customer need, the visual or commercial rule, its implementation in the site, and an observable signal. This prevents vague preferences and copied tactics whose purpose is not understood.

blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Read the first error and repair methodically is like arranging a physical shop: every color, space, message, or offer should help a visitor understand where they are, what they can buy, and why they can trust the next step.

Reproduce, read file and line, reduce the case, verify the hypothesis, and rerun types and build instead of editing randomly. Name the precise problem before selecting a tool. Observe context, device, intent, and customer objections. Then write a hypothesis that links one change to an expected result without presenting that hypothesis as established fact.

To master Read the first error and repair methodically, first build a minimal version with explicit rules, then inspect it on mobile and desktop. Contrast normal, empty, long, and error cases. Quality comes from a coherent testable system, not from accumulating visual effects or promotional messages.

This lesson delivers a debugging log with symptom, hypothesis, and evidence. It must record the starting situation, decision, expected evidence, and safety limit. Compare behavior and before/after metrics over enough time while accounting for traffic, costs, and satisfaction.
